headline: Yi-Chia Chen adds to ARC-3 lead

sections.text: Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model gained 3.27 to reach 71.48, holding first place on the ARC-AGI-3 public board. Tufa Labs remains second at 68.91, unchanged.
The lead change was reported yesterday; this fresh score gain extends Chen’s advantage in the current public standings.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
